text: dsh-notifications 是面向 DSH 网页版的提醒插件，通过浏览器客户端追踪主会话状态和待处理交互，并可轮询 agy-cli 会话。主线程完成、出现问题或审批请求时，它发送桌面通知和本地双音提示，并在浏览器标签图标上显示红点；点击通知可回到对应会话。用户可在首次提示或通用设置中授权通知、测试、关闭提醒或静音。适合需要离开 DSH 页面时及时获知任务结束或需要处理请求的用户。使用时需保持已连接的 DSH 标签页，浏览器通知需授权，提示音需通过用户交互解锁。

dsh-notifications alerts DSH Web users when a main session finishes or needs attention. It shows desktop alerts with an optional local chime and a red tab icon; clicking an alert returns to its session. Enable notifications in settings, grant browser permission, and keep a connected tab open.
DSH 主会话跑完时，能不能弹个桌面提醒？
有待回答的问题或审批时提醒我，并让我点一下就回到会话。
Notify me when a DSH Web task finishes or needs my attention, even when its tab is in the background.
dsh-notifications 的功能「会话通知」：监听主线程结束以及问题、审批或计划审阅等待处理请求，触发浏览器桌面通知和可选的本地双音提示。点击通知会聚焦 DSH 并打开对应会话；设置页可测试或关闭通知。
dsh-notifications 的功能「未读标签提示」：主线程产生完成或待处理事件时，在浏览器标签页图标上加红点；返回页面、聚焦窗口或进行交互后清除，并恢复原图标。

dsh-notifications README · dsh-notifications：Desktop notifications and a two-note chime for DeepSeek Harness Web. Runs in your browser, including through an SSH forward such as `http://127.0.0.1:3084/` → server port 3080. No external notification service, audio download, or model tool is needed.

dsh-notifications README · dsh-notifications：On first load, click **Enable notifications**, then **Allow** in the browser. This also enables audio and sends a test notification. Open **Settings → General → Notifications** to test again, mute the chime, or disable alerts. Preferences belong to the current browser and origin; changing the forwarded port requires permission again.

dsh-notifications README · dsh-notifications：If you only hear sound, the test control reports whether desktop delivery is requested, reported shown by the browser, or failed. The chime does not prove a desktop banner was displayed. Allow banners for your browser in the operating system notification settings and check Do Not Disturb. Each test creates a new notification and requests that it remain visible until dismissed; browser support varies.

dsh-notifications README · Events：Notifications show the project directory name as the title and a short body: **Finished**, the first pending question, **Approval needed**, or **Review plan**. Question previews collapse whitespace and stop at 180 characters. Sessions without a project directory use their display title.

dsh-notifications README · Events：The browser tab icon also gets a red dot for these events. Returning to the tab, focusing its window, or interacting with the page clears it. This works in every DSH tab even when desktop notifications are disabled or blocked. The original favicon is restored when the dot clears or the plugin unloads.

dsh-notifications README · Events：- A main thread changes from running to stopped, including normal completion, cancellation, and failure. Each run alerts once. Initial idle history and reconnect snapshots do not alert.
- An Antigravity CLI (`agy-cli`) main conversation finishes a run (`CASCADE_RUN_STATUS_RUNNING` → `CASCADE_RUN_STATUS_IDLE`, or completes new steps). Clicking the alert focuses DSH on port 3080 and opens that conversation in the Antigravity tab of `dsh-codex-sessions`.
- A main thread has a pending question, approval, or plan review. Each request alerts once; a simultaneous stop while that request is pending does not produce another alert.
- Subagent threads stay silent. A manually forked conversation remains an independent main thread.
- Clicking an alert focuses DSH and opens its thread. A single tab owns automatic notification delivery when several tabs share an origin; another tab takes over when it closes.

dsh-notifications README · Events：Keep a DSH tab open and connected. Desktop browser notifications are supported; closed-tab push and mobile service-worker notifications are outside this plugin. Sound requires a user interaction after a fresh page load: click the page or use the test button. Browser/OS notification settings, Do Not Disturb, suspended tabs, and SSH connectivity can affect delivery. No stale completions are replayed after an outage. The first tab owning notification delivery must have audio unlocked to chime.

dsh-notifications README · Option 1: Direct from GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dat-lequoc/dsh-notifications
dsh --profile web
```

dsh-notifications README · Option 2: Build and pack locally：```sh

npm run check
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-notifications-0.1.1.tgz

dsh-notifications README · Option 2: Build and pack locally：The package contains its built browser bundle. It uses DSH's `sessions`, `uiSession.pendingInteractions`, Remote session status events, locale dictionaries, `shell.overlay`, and `settings.general.item` extension points. Verified against local DSH `0.1.5-rc.1`. The host entry only enrolls the browser module; it exposes no server routes or model capabilities. No separate invariant provider is necessary because the plugin owns no mirrored Host state.

dsh-notifications README · Option 2: Build and pack locally：For local development, link this directory as a profile dependency and insert the plugin in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-notifications
      name: dsh-notifications
```

Choose either the bundle installer or this explicit patch, so the plugin is mounted once. Live patch reload can activate the explicit entry without restarting DSH. Rebuild with `npm run build` after client changes; DSH client HMR serves the rebuilt bundle.

dsh-notifications README · Verification：`npm run check` runs keyless behavior tests, builds the package, and syntax-checks the browser artifact. `scripts/verify-live.mjs` uses Playwright against an existing authenticated DSH server; pass `DSH_LOG` pointing to that server's startup log. It keeps the login token out of reports. It checks native Notification construction, real Web Audio oscillator scheduling, controls, persistence, thread navigation, attention kinds, and multi-tab ownership. It injects synthetic events only into its isolated browser; it never prompts a model or changes Host sessions. Screenshots, videos, and reports go into ignored `verification/`.

dsh-notifications README · Verification：Browser requirements: [MDN Notifications API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Notifications_API/Using_the_Notifications_API) and [AudioContext.resume](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AudioContext/resume).
